TechnoCore Engineering (Pvt) Ltd brings a proven, governed delivery model to the Ministry’s requirement to establish and operate a centralized 24x7 SOC with SIEM/SOAR-enabled Managed Detection & Response over a three-year term. We are ISO 27001 certified, aligning our operations to an information security management system suitable for handling sensitive government telemetry, incident data, and response workflows. [CO-PROFILE] We also operate under ISO 9001 and CMMI L3 disciplines, supporting repeatable processes for SOC onboarding, runbook governance, and SLA-driven operations. [CO-PROFILE]

Our differentiator is delivery at scale across mixed environments (data centre, network, and cloud) with multi-year operational commitments. We have executed cybersecurity and infrastructure deployments up to 33–34 months in duration, including a Federal Government cloud infrastructure deployment and multiple cybersecurity engagements, demonstrating our ability to sustain operational cadence, reporting, and stakeholder management over long horizons. [CAP-012] [CAP-001] [CAP-013] Our footprint spans Federal and Provincial Government, private sector, and international engagements, supporting the Ministry’s need to extend monitoring across connected federal entities. [CO-PROFILE] [CAP-012] [CAP-049]

For 24x7 continuity, we are structured for in-country delivery with offices in Islamabad (HQ), Lahore, and Karachi, and an established support desk model with defined response SLAs. [CO-PROFILE]

Two mandatory items require explicit mitigation:
- Turnover threshold: our evidenced average annual turnover is PKR 900M (3 audited years), below PKR 1,200M; we will address this via an eligible consortium/prime-sub arrangement. [CO-PROFILE]
- Tier certifications: our library does not yet evidence CISSP/GIAC coverage for L1/L2/L3; we will staff the SOC with certified hires/partners and submit CVs and proofs at bid stage. [CO-PROFILE]
